_concept: ASSET REGISTRY — every durable thing a session produces, declared with its provenance and the method that made it
_one_line: An asset nobody registered is an asset nobody will find. Knowledge that lives only where it was created dies with the session that created it.

_why.trigger: s097 extracted two new Gold DB tables (df14l, tadir_obj) that unlock the entire bottom-up direction of the model — and registered them NOWHERE. They existed on disk, invisible to the registry, to the brain and to the next session. The very session that argued knowledge must not stay in the conversation left its most valuable new asset undeclared.
_why.principle: Three things must land, every time: the RESULT (what we found), the METHOD (how to find it again), and the ASSET (what the finding produced). Two out of three is a slow leak.
_why.enforcement: brain_v2/methods/verify_assets.py — gated in rebuild_all. A declared asset that is missing, or a Gold DB table that nobody declared, FAILS the rebuild. This is the guarantee; the paragraph above is only the reason.

_asset_kinds.gold_table: a table in the Golden DB. LOCAL-ONLY — gitignored, ~6.4GB. Git does not protect it; only a disk/offsite backup does.
_asset_kinds.store: a JSON store under brain_v2/ — git-tracked, part of the brain
_asset_kinds.tool: a runnable script that regenerates an asset or performs a method
_asset_kinds.doc: a knowledge document — the prose layer
_asset_kinds.gold_database: a whole SQLite golden database, one per SAP system. The FILE is the environment — this is what makes provenance structural instead of a naming convention.
_asset_kinds.algorithm: a TECHNIQUE, portable across domains and problems. Distinct from a tool (one binding of an algorithm to one problem) and from a method (an activity with a cadence). The value of an analysis product IS its algorithms: what a buyer pays Celonis or Signavio for is conformance checking and object-centric mining, not storage. Declared in brain_v2/methods/algorithms.json.
_asset_kinds.normative_model: a statement of what CORRECT means for a flow, as rules that can be evaluated and violations that can be priced. The conformance ALGORITHM is the market's; this content is ours, and it is where the moat is.

df14l.what_it_is: SAP application-component hierarchy: FCTR_ID -> PS_POSID (e.g. HLA0006110 -> FI-AA-AA)
df14l.why_it_matters: The final rung of the deterministic chain object -> package -> component id -> APPLICATION COMPONENT. Without it the bottom-up direction of the model does not exist and module attribution falls back to guessing from package names.
df14l.gotchas: no PARENT_ID field; full reads and LIKE both return TABLE_WITHOUT_DATA; EQ only; <=40 OR-terms per call

tadir_obj.provenance: P01 TADIR via RFC (read-only), 10 object types
tadir_obj.why_it_matters: tadir_prog covered PROG only, which is ~4% of the graph's objects. Tables, function groups, classes and transactions had no package and therefore no component. Spanning object TYPES is what took the ascent from 4% to its current level.
tadir_obj.gotchas: P01 rejects ROWSKIPS -> hard cap of 40,000 rows per object type; chunk by name range to go beyond

system_profile.what_it_is: THE UNESCO PROFILE — installed / configured / productive per module, org structure, add-ons, front-end, users, operating model
system_profile.why_it_matters: The class of question 'what is this tenant?' had no home. Answering it live from cvers + audit logs produced six wrong module verdicts.

installation.what_it_is: the ROOT object — identity, axes, pointers, deterministic firing order
installation.why_it_matters: 16 parallel layers and no root. The subject of the model was implicit everywhere and first-class nowhere.
installation.produced_by: hand-authored (the ROOT is a modelling decision, not an extraction)

model_graph.what_it_is: ascent + coherence + cross-cutting overlay + domain tree

model_ascent.what_it_is: one row per object: its climb to the installation and the ladder rung that resolved it
model_ascent.why_separate: brain_state is at ~84% of the context window; the full ascent stays queryable on disk rather than travelling with every session (CP-002: preserve, do not force into context)

maturity_methods.what_it_is: the 8 repeatable activities + 4 anti-methods + the promotion lifecycle
maturity_methods.why_it_matters: Results age. The activities that produce them compound.
maturity_methods.produced_by: hand-authored (the method catalogue is itself a modelling artifact)

probe_footprint.what_it_is: bounded read-only probe of module footprint
probe_footprint.promoted_from: a scratchpad script — where it would have been deleted with the session

tadir_prog.why_it_matters: first rung of the object->component chain, for programs. Superseded in breadth by tadir_obj (10 object types) but kept: it is the source the s092 execution map was built on.
tadir_prog.note: UNDECLARED until s097 — found by the asset gate on its first run, together with tdevc. Both are load-bearing for the bottom-up model and neither was visible to the registry.

tdevc.what_it_is: development package -> software component (DLVUNIT) + application component id (COMPONENT)
tdevc.why_it_matters: the middle rung: without it, packages cannot reach DF14L and the chain breaks.

bseg_union.what_it_is: VIEW over BSIS/BSAS/BSIK/BSAK/BSID/BSAD — BSEG is a JOIN, never extracted (rule feedback_bseg_is_join_not_table)
bseg_union.why_it_matters: the Golden Query depends on it

d01_golden_db.what_it_is: the D01 (development) golden DB — created s097; D01 data had been living inside the P01 file
d01_golden_db.why_it_matters: provenance becomes STRUCTURAL: the file IS the environment. The d01_/p01_ prefix convention was a promise and it was broken.
d01_golden_db.note: source tables NOT dropped from the P01 DB — retiring them waits for a confirmed backup (assets_backed_up=0.00)

sap_installation_profiling_skill.what_it_is: THE SUPER SKILL — 10 phases to profile any SAP installation end to end, KIT vs INSTANCE separated
sap_installation_profiling_skill.why_it_matters: the product is the machine, not the insight. This is what instantiates against organisation #2.

split_golden_by_system.what_it_is: one golden DB per SAP system; copies + verifies, never drops

capability_catalogue.what_it_is: every capability: what it does, how it helps the model, its honest STATE, and the specific lever to improve it
capability_catalogue.why_it_matters: A tool path in a table cannot be judged. Without a stated contribution and a stated improvement path, no capability ever gets re-evaluated and weak ones survive indefinitely because nobody can see they are weak.
capability_catalogue.cadence: re-walk per close; move at least one STATE upward

audit_skill_coverage.what_it_is: audits the portable skill against the real tool surface: orphaned / phantom / missing cadence
audit_skill_coverage.why_it_matters: the skill was written from memory and covered 11% of capability. This made it visible; now 92.7%.

domain_capability_strategy.produced_by: analysis over executed_objects_domain_map + domains registry + capability_model
domain_capability_strategy.what_it_is: capabilities classified BY DOMAIN, redundancy exposed, the Public Sector thesis, the trigger model
domain_capability_strategy.why_it_matters: where to invest: FI/CO/MM competent (table stakes); BCS/FM/PBC/GM/PS-FM excellent (nobody else is there).

check_triggers.what_it_is: evaluates ACCUMULATION / MATURITY / INTERPRETATION triggers and returns what to re-run and why
check_triggers.why_it_matters: a cadence written in a document is a wish. This makes the loop fire on evidence.

domain_capability_matrix.what_it_is: per domain: activity vs assets, investment tier, coverage inversion, differentiator health
domain_capability_matrix.why_it_matters: the coverage-inversion finding was computed once by hand in a script that no longer exists. That is reflection. This regenerates.

build_domain_capability_matrix.what_it_is: generates the matrix + measures the product thesis

process_flows.produced_by: architectural analysis + pm4py implementations already in the repo
process_flows.what_it_is: the FLOW layer: end-to-end chains that cross components and domains, with many-to-many edges, normative references, and the public-sector flows the market has no content for
process_flows.why_it_matters: domains keyed on SAP modules are a technical taxonomy wearing a business name. Nobody does 'FI'. And a component serves SEVERAL flows — FI-BL-PT pays suppliers, staff, travellers and treasury. A 1:1 module→domain map cannot express that. Process mining must run on flows, which is why every vendor names content P2P/O2C/R2R.

algo:A1_chunked_temporal_read.what_it_is: read a purging log in bounded time windows (<=6h) because a wide call hangs and the connection degrades every ~12 calls
algo:A1_chunked_temporal_read.failure_mode: a silently truncated window looks like a quiet period in the data
algo:A1_chunked_temporal_read.produced_by: declared as a technique; bound in the tools listed

algo:A2_rolling_window_accumulation.what_it_is: capture a window the source purges (7-120 days) into *_history tables, turning a window into a history
algo:A2_rolling_window_accumulation.failure_mode: a missed day is invisible: the history simply has a hole nobody sees
algo:A2_rolling_window_accumulation.produced_by: declared as a technique; bound in the tools listed

algo:A3_two_axis_classification.what_it_is: explain every call on two independent axes — PROCESS (from the object name) and ORIGIN (from host/destination/user)
algo:A3_two_axis_classification.failure_mode: an unresolved origin collapses a fleet into one label — 174 middleware endpoints currently read as one caller
algo:A3_two_axis_classification.produced_by: declared as a technique; bound in the tools listed

algo:A4_ordered_classifier_ladder.what_it_is: ordered rule chain (package -> software component -> overlay -> name -> text -> substrate); first match wins, specificity expressed by ORDER
algo:A4_ordered_classifier_ladder.failure_mode: ORDER-DEPENDENCE IS SILENT. A greedy early rule steals from a later one and nothing errors. Proven twice in s097: 'FTB' swallowed FTBB (bank statements) into deal management; an inline comment swallowed two dict entries and moved 70,766 executions between domains.
algo:A4_ordered_classifier_ladder.produced_by: declared as a technique; bound in the tools listed

algo:A5_adaptive_learning_loop.what_it_is: auto-resolve unknown calls by function group / naming / app domain, LEARN the resolution, re-classify until convergence, expose the remainder as an explicit frontier
algo:A5_adaptive_learning_loop.failure_mode: a learned rule that was wrong once is now wrong permanently and invisibly
algo:A5_adaptive_learning_loop.produced_by: declared as a technique; bound in the tools listed

algo:A6_frontier_with_substrate_tier.what_it_is: coverage % + explicit worklist, with a third tier for technical substrate (connectivity, session, monitoring): real execution, legitimately non-business
algo:A6_frontier_with_substrate_tier.failure_mode: substrate becomes a dumping ground if it is ever matched before business rules — it is matched LAST on purpose
algo:A6_frontier_with_substrate_tier.produced_by: declared as a technique; bound in the tools listed

algo:B1_dfg_discovery.what_it_is: build the process map from an event log — activities as nodes, observed transitions as edges
algo:B1_dfg_discovery.failure_mode: a DFG on the wrong case notion produces a plausible map of a process that does not exist
algo:B1_dfg_discovery.produced_by: declared as a technique; bound in the tools listed

algo:B2_variant_analysis.what_it_is: group cases by exact path, rank by frequency and cost — the long tail is where exceptions live
algo:B2_variant_analysis.failure_mode: variants computed on a truncated log look like process simplicity
algo:B2_variant_analysis.produced_by: declared as a technique; bound in the tools listed

algo:B3_performance_bottleneck.what_it_is: cycle time per transition; waiting versus processing
algo:B3_performance_bottleneck.failure_mode: timestamps from different systems make a bottleneck out of a clock skew
algo:B3_performance_bottleneck.produced_by: declared as a technique; bound in the tools listed

algo:B4_declarative_conformance.failure_mode: applying a market normative model without checking the tenant's real shape. A standard O2C model here would report 100% non-conformance because there are ZERO deliveries — a false finding.

algo:C1_component_resolution_chain.failure_mode: a name-range chunk that returns exactly the cap truncates silently
algo:C1_component_resolution_chain.produced_by: declared as a technique; bound in the tools listed

algo:C2_ascent_with_provenance_rung.failure_mode: measuring the percentage against the wrong denominator. s097: 182 synthesised concepts and 24 users counted as 'unresolved' when they can never carry a component.

algo:E1_crossing.produced_by: declared as a technique; bound in the tools listed

algo:E2_coherence.produced_by: declared as a technique; bound in the tools listed

algo:F1_interface_boundary_analysis.produced_by: built s097 — it was the one MISSING algorithm in the catalogue

algorithms_registry.what_it_is: the algorithm asset class: technique, operand, origin, state, binding, failure mode
algorithms_registry.why_it_matters: an algorithm fails differently from a tool. A broken tool fails loudly; a subtly wrong algorithm produces confident, plausible, WRONG output. You cannot review what you have not named.

algorithm_catalogue.what_it_is: the readable form, organised by the data each algorithm operates on

process_flows_store.what_it_is: the flow layer: end-to-end chains crossing components and domains

domain_assets.what_it_is: the asset bundle PER DOMAIN — tables, extraction, algorithms, knowledge, flows
domain_assets.why_it_matters: assets were catalogued by KIND and never by DOMAIN, so nobody could say what a domain has or lacks

build_domain_assets.what_it_is: inverts the asset index from kind-major to domain-major

normative_models.produced_by: authored — move 3 of the algorithm doctrine
normative_models.what_it_is: AS-DESIGNED reference per flow: rules, severity, quantification, declared exceptions
normative_models.why_it_matters: one normative model existed before this (P2P). The four public-sector flows that carry the organisation's primary financial control had none.

component_map.what_it_is: package -> application component -> canonical domain, longest-prefix wins
component_map.why_it_matters: 28,053 packages resolve. Replaces guessing a module from a package NAME with SAP stating the answer. Ordering is irrelevant by construction, which is precisely what an ordered regex ladder cannot promise.

tfdir_all.provenance: P01 TFDIR via RFC, chunked by first character
tfdir_all.why_it_matters: function modules are NOT repository objects: they belong to a function GROUP. Without this hop the frontier was dominated by BAPIs — BAPI_PR_GETDETAIL, BAPI_TRIP_CHECK_STATUS, BAPI_PO_GETDETAIL1 — which are exactly the satellite calls behind the 80%-external headline. The model was blind to its own main finding.

attach_object_text.what_it_is: joins transaction/report text onto every executed object
attach_object_text.why_it_matters: the frontier was 3,631 NAMES. This does not improve the classification, it makes it REVIEWABLE.

validate_algorithms.what_it_is: 40 golden cases — every one a real defect found the hard way, turned into a regression test
validate_algorithms.why_it_matters: running without error is not validation. The classifier ran for months filing Project System cost reports under Controlling and never errored once.

interface_boundary.why_it_matters: the 37-flow integration map was PROSE. This makes the boundary discoverable, diffable and reproducible on another installation.

improve_algorithms.what_it_is: the continuous-improvement mechanism: which algorithm to improve next, from five measured signals
improve_algorithms.why_it_matters: a catalogue says what exists and golden cases stop regressions; neither answers WHICH ONE NEXT. Without that, improvement goes wherever attention falls.

validate_algorithms_tool.what_it_is: 40 golden cases, each a real defect turned into a regression test

algo:C1c_custom_fm_domain.what_it_is: custom Z/Y function module -> domain via the curated overlay

portability.what_it_is: per-rung breakdown: what travels, what does not, and what it would cost to redo

algo:A7_concept_drift.what_it_is: concept drift over the accumulated history

drift_signals.what_it_is: which domain changed shape, when, and by how much

run_analysis_cycle.why_it_matters: 'on demand' is a euphemism for 'never runs' when nobody demands it. Twelve algorithms were in that state: real code producing nothing because no trigger fired them. An algorithm that does not run is documentation.

_the_guarantee.question: How do we guarantee that exploration becomes part of the model rather than staying in a conversation?
_the_guarantee.wrong_answer: By remembering to write it down. Discipline is not a mechanism; it fails exactly when the session is long and interesting, which is when the discoveries happen.
right_answer: 1. RESULT lands as a claim with evidence (gated: claims_health).
2. METHOD lands in model_maturity_methods.json or method_registry.py, at stage>=3 (wired) — not as a note.
3. ASSET lands here, and verify_assets.py FAILS the rebuild if a declared asset is missing or an undeclared Gold DB table appears.
4. The TOOL lives in the product tree, never in a scratchpad. A script under a temp directory is deleted knowledge.
_the_guarantee.test: Delete this conversation. Can the next session reproduce every finding from the repository alone? If not, something is still trapped in the chat.
